data.one_liner: Provides a SliverPersistentHeader that automatically adapts its height to its child content.
data.what_it_does: The widget measures its child without height constraints and updates the sliver height to match the content. It supports pinned and floating behavior and optional repaint control.
use_when: You need a header in a CustomScrollView whose height varies with its content
You want to avoid hard‑coding header heights
You need smooth scrolling with adaptive header size
avoid_when: Header size is static and known beforehand
Performance is critical on low‑end devices and frequent size changes
strengths: Works with pinned and floating headers
Simple API with optional initialHeight for performance
weaknesses: Adds a measurement step that may impact performance on very dynamic content

alternatives.name: after_layout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a generic way to run code after a widget is laid out, useful for size measurement without a dedicated sliver header
